subject: [PATCH 3/6] memcg: group the write-hot fields of struct mem_cgroup

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch groups the write-hot fields of struct mem_cgroup into a single cache line to improve performance by reducing cache line contention between read-mostly and write-hot fields. The fields are moved from their current scattered locations throughout the structure to a new group, which is aligned with a cacheline boundary. A new function, memcg_struct_check(), is added to ensure that any future changes to the struct do not move these fields out of their designated cache line group. This change has no functional impact on the system's behavior.
